defs.def: the conditions and facts that are connected with and affect a situation, an event or an action 条件；环境；状况

ex.s: So many of us have the belief that being comfortabel is the only state we will tolerate, and when we experience something outside of our comfort zone, we get impatient about the circumstances.
ex.t: 我们许多人都有这样的信念：舒适是唯一我们能容忍的状态，当我们经历舒适区之外的事时，就会对处境失去耐心。

ex.s: He  29  me to find the best in all difficult circumstances.
ex.t: 他29 我在所有困难的处境中发现最好的一面。

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近，我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关的新计时方法，而这些状况可能因全球变暖而改变。我们现在正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座时钟，它反映阿拉斯加几条主要河流的总流量，这些河流对地方和全球的环境变化十分敏感。我们已对它编程：如果水道继续以目前速率流动，它就与原子钟同步；如果未来河流平均流速加快，时钟就会跑在标准时间前面；如果变慢，则会出现相反效果。

ex.s: Her circumstances are beyond our control.
ex.t: 她的情况超出了我们的控制范围。

defs.def: the conditions of a person's life, especially the money they have 境况；境遇；（尤指）经济状况

ex.s: Comparing yourself with someone who is outperforming you could result in feelings of envy if you focus on the things they have and you don’t, or it can be energizing and inspiring if you use these comparisons as a source of motivation, for example, “If they can achieve that, so can I.” Comparing yourself with someone who is doing worse than you could result in fear and worry if you think about how you could fall into similar circumstances, or it can draw out feelings of gratitude and appreciation if you use that comparison to broaden your views — for example, “Wow, things could be much worse; I’m doing great.”
ex.t: 把自己和表现优于你的人比较，如果你盯着他们有而你没有的东西，可能产生嫉妒；但如果你把这些比较当作动力来源，比如“他们能做到，我也能”，它就会令人振奋和鼓舞。把自己和不如你的人比较，如果你想到自己也可能陷入类似境地，可能产生恐惧和担忧；但如果你用这种比较拓宽视角，比如“哇，情况可能更糟，我已经很不错了”，它就会引发感恩和知足。

ex.s: They can change according to circumstances.
Whether big or small, what all our choices have in common is that they leads to specific consequences Once we make a decision, in most circumstances, there is no going back.
ex.t: 无论大小，我们所有的选择都有一个共同点，即它们会导致特定的后果一旦我们做出决定，在大多数情况下，就无法回头。

defs.def: situations and events that affect and influence your life and that are not in your control 命运；客观环境

ex.s: You can view these practices as a toolbox meant to aid your efforts to build a minimalist lifestyle that words for your particular circumstances.
ex.t: 你可以把这些练习看作一个工具箱，用来帮助你打造适合自己特定情况的极简生活方式。

ex.s: Your personal circumstances are equally important.
ex.t: 你的个人处境同样重要。

ex.s: These discoveries all help us understand the capacity for life on our planet, even in the most extreme circumstances.
ex.t: 这些发现都有助于我们了解地球上生命的能力，即使在最极端的情况下也是如此。

ex.s: Once we make a decision, in most circumstances, there is no going back.
ex.t: 在大多数情况下，一旦我们做出决定，就无法回头。

ex.s: However, we do have some power of choice, and we do control the most important thing of all: how we respond to circumstances.
ex.t: 但是，我们确实有一定的选择权，我们确实控制着最重要的事情：我们如何应对环境。
